DeepSeek.Chat.Settings.ApiKeyGuideDescri: DeepSeek, Baidu, and Bing API keys are stored in Visual Studio Credential Storage; configure them on the legacy options page.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.enableWebSearch.d: Enable web search functionality. When enabled, a web search toggle will appear in the chat window.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.enableTelemetryEx: After each agent session, export metrics (TTFT, turns, tokens, tool calls) as a JSON file to %LocalAppData%\DeepSeekVS\telemetry\ for performance analysis and benchmarking.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.enableAutoBuild.d: Whether to automatically invoke Build Agent to compile and verify after Edit Agent completes code modifications. When disabled, the build step appears as a button for you to trigger manually. You can also use phrases like 'don't build' or 'skip build' in your prompt to temporarily skip the build. Default: enabled.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.autocompleteConti: When enabled, accepting a completion immediately triggers a new prediction.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.preserveRecentTur:
During compression, keep the most recent N turns of conversation uncompressed.
Default 3 turns. Increase to preserve more immediate context.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.ragTopK.descripti: Maximum number of documents to retrieve from the knowledge base per query. Default 5.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.enableIdeContextI: On each message, automatically provide the AI with the active file, cursor position, selected code and a summary of current-file errors/warnings (injected as volatile context; does not affect prefix cache hits). Deep queries remain available via tools like get_errors.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.ocrEngine.descrip:
Select image OCR engine:
  • Windows Built-in — System built-in, no configuration needed, moderate accuracy
  • PaddleOCR-Sharp — Local offline recognition with higher Chinese accuracy
  • Remote OCR service via MCP protocol
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.enableRag.descrip:
Enable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to automatically retrieve relevant documents from the knowledge base before conversation.
Requires configuring a RAG provider (such as a local vector database).
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.maxConsecutiveErr: Terminate when all tool calls in N consecutive rounds return errors. Default: 5.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.systemPromptEn.de: English version of the system prompt. Used when UI language is set to English.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.autocompleteEnabl: Enable inline code completion (ghost text) in the editor. When enabled, DeepSeek will provide code completion suggestions as you type. Press Tab to accept, Escape to cancel.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.themeMode.descrip: Interface theme: Auto (follow VS), Dark, or Light
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.searchProvider.de: Select search engine: Baidu (Baidu Qianfan, requires API Key, 1500 free/month), Bing (Azure, requires API Key, 1000 free/month), or DuckDuckGo (completely free)
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.systemPrompt.desc: System prompt that defines the AI assistant's behavior and role
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.tokenBudget.descr:
DeepSeek V4 has a 1M token context window.
This setting controls the maximum tokens sent to the API (reserving 100K for model output).
Default is 900,000. Reduce to lower API costs; increase for more context.
Show current token usage in the status bar (used/budget).
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.language.descript:
Choose display language. Select 'Auto' to follow system language.
选择显示语言。「自动」则跟随系统语言。
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.compressionThresh:
Trigger auto-compression when context usage reaches this percentage.
Default 85%, i.e., triggers at ~765K tokens of a 900K budget.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.maxToolCallRounds: Maximum number of tool call rounds allowed in a single agent session. The conversation will be forced to end with a warning when this limit is reached. Default: 200.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.llmTimeoutSeconds: Timeout for a single LLM API request. Default 300 seconds; streaming has a separate 120-second no-data disconnect detection that is unaffected by this setting.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.autocompleteDelay: How many milliseconds to wait after you stop typing before requesting completion suggestions.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.approvalMode.desc: Controls the approval behavior for tool operations (terminal commands, file deletion, etc.): • SmartBlock — Only dangerous commands require approval; safe commands auto-approved • BlockAll — All terminal commands and file operations require user approval • AllowAll — Auto-approve all operations without asking ( use with caution)
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.bottomAreaScale.d: Scale all text and controls below WebView2 by percentage (50-300). Default: 100%.
DeepSeek.Chat.Settings.CategoryDescripti: Non-sensitive DeepSeek Chat settings; API keys are stored in Visual Studio Credential Storage.
DeepSeek.Chat.Settings.ApiKeyGuideMessag: API keys are not included in Unified Settings. Configure them in Tools > Options > DeepSeek Chat > General.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.showDiffMarkers.d: After AI writes code, show red/green line markers in the editor (green=added, red=deleted) with confirm/revert buttons. When disabled, changes take effect directly without preview.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.maxRepeatedSameCa: When the same tool is called with the same arguments more than this many times AND returns the same result each time, it is treated as an infinite loop and the conversation is terminated. Default: 5.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.inputBoxHeight.de: Fixed height for the chat input box (50-500). Default: 50.
DeepSeek.Chat.Settings.WebView2ZoomDescr: Chat page zoom percentage; usually updated automatically by page zoom operations.
DeepSeek.Chat.settings.enableAutoCompres:
When context approaches the token budget, automatically compress early conversation into summaries
rather than deleting old messages. When disabled, falls back to the old truncation behavior.
